reply_text:
Found two issues in `main...receipt-lines` (`a6c40d4`). I’d fix the first before merging.

1. **[P1] Printed amounts are 100× too large** — `receipt/render.py:2`  
   `format_money()` formats integer cents directly as dollars without dividing by 100. For example, `format_money(1299)` returns `$1299.00` instead of `$12.99`; two coffees at 450 cents print as `$900.00` instead of `$9.00`. This violates the money contract already on `main`.  
   The render test misses this because its expected value also calls `format_money()`. Add literal expected-dollar assertions.

2. **[P2] The renderer never uses the new right-alignment helper** — `receipt/render.py:7`  
   `render_line()` still pads the name to 20 characters and appends the amount, so amounts of different lengths end in different columns rather than at the 32-character receipt edge. `layout.align()` works in isolation but isn’t connected to the printed output. Route rendering through it and test the actual rendered line’s width and amount position.

**Validation:** All three existing tests pass. No files changed.
